messages:
alice_support: Filing follow-up for ticket 78344 — ACME seeing repeated 503s + JWT auth fails on their Dedicated cluster in eu-west-2a. Customer pasted req-id `req-0a1b2c3d`. Asking for pod + node level artifacts and a GPU snapshot.

customer_acme: yes — ~30-60s tail spikes, then 503s for some requests. sample curl below. happy to run commands if you tell me what to collect.

customer_acme: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Request-ID: req-0a1b2c3d" https://api.redwood.company/v1/generate -d @prompt.json```

bryan_oncall: on it. pls confirm pod name and a recent request id — we need the pod logs + node dmesg + nvidia-smi + /var/log/messages. if you can reproduce, include the exact X-Request-ID header.

alice_support: pod name from customer: `acme-inference-5f4b7d9c4f-2xk9p`. customer says it happens across 2 pods.

carmen_runtime: for repro let's also capture tracing headers. ask customer to add `X-Trace: trace-acme-78344` to the curl so traces link across services. we need KVS cache hits for the request too.

devin_platform: I'll kick off a sysprof snapshot on the node and enable GPU telemetry collection. steps for customer to run (if they can):
```
kubectl -n acme logs deploy/acme-inference -c inference --since=10m > acme-pod.log
kubectl -n acme get pods -o wide | grep acme-inference
ssh core@NODE_IP 'sudo dmesg -T > dmesg.out; sudo cat /var/log/messages | tail -n 200 > sysmessages.tail'
ssh core@NODE_IP 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,name,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,temperature.gpu --format=csv -l 1 -f gpu_stream.csv & sleep 10; pkill -f nvidia-smi'
sudo tar -czf acme-78344-artefacts.tgz acme-pod.log dmesg.out sysmessages.tail gpu_stream.csv
# upload
aws s3 cp acme-78344-artefacts.tgz s3://redwood-debug/acme/78344/
```

alice_support: customer asked for minimal commands they can run without node SSH. can they at least provide `kubectl logs` + pod env + `kubectl exec -it pod -- nvidia-smi` output?

customer_acme: yes we can do kubectl logs and exec nvidia-smi. will run now and upload to the S3 path you provided.

ticketbot: Ticket 78344 created and linked to internal incident INC-4621. Please attach artifacts to s3://redwood-debug/acme/78344/ — retention 30d.

bryan_oncall: once artifacts are up, I will run the trace correlator to find backend spans matching `req-0a1b2c3d` and `trace-acme-78344`. also check for auth-service 401->503 transition.

customer_acme: uploaded: s3://redwood-debug/acme/78344/acme-78344-artefacts.tgz (sha256: d6f9ab...) — includes pod logs + nvidia-smi output.

carmen_runtime: grabbing bundle now. quick grep I want run locally: `grep -E "req-0a1b2c3d|trace-acme-78344|ERROR|timeout|KV_CACHE" acme-pod.log`. also check for long GC pauses or OOM kills in sysmessages.tail.

bryan_oncall: early signal: GPU utilization looks fine, but I see repeated grpc timeouts between inference node and model-server around the same timestamps as the 503s. pulling kernel XID traces next.

devin_platform: added a lightweight metric exporter to node to record pci bus errors; no obvious ECC errors. I'll attach the sysprof snapshot here once processed.

alice_support: thanks all. next steps: eng-runtime (carmen) to validate model-server logs for request id mapping, oncall (bryan) to correlate network/gRPC failures, platform (devin) to sanity-check GPU metrics. customer — stand by for short follow-ups, and thanks for uploading. :thumbsup:

bryan_oncall: internal note — moving to eng-releases if we confirm model-server regression; otherwise will close after 72h if no recurrence.

carmen_runtime: got the bundle, will post minimal findings in this thread in ~30m.

customer_acme: appreciate the quick turnaround. will try reproducing with a few different sequence lengths and report back.

carmen_runtime: (summary) grep found backend span timeouts and a couple of repeated `KV_CACHE` misses that triggered fallbacks; next I will instrument a targeted canary to repro under controlled load.

bryan_oncall: ACK. if we need more data, we'll ask customer to run the curl with `-H "X-Collect-Debug: 1"` so we can capture full request trace without SSH.

alice_support: closing the loop here — artifacts saved, initial triage done, follow-up actions assigned. moving thread to incidents channel when we have final RCA.
